hints.text: The fraction bar means divide. Ask how many whole groups of five can be made from seventeen fifths.
$5 \times 3 = 15$, so $3$ wholes fit inside $17$ fifths. Subtract to see how many fifths are left over.

explanation: The fraction $\frac{17}{5}$ means $17 \div 5$, and every $5$ fifths make one whole.
Since $5 \times 3 = 15$, three whole groups of five fit inside $17$.
What is left is $17 - 15 = 2$, and those $2$ pieces are still fifths.
So the mixed number is $\frac{17}{5} = 3\frac{2}{5}$, which is $3.4$ as a decimal.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count up by wholes
steps: From $\frac{15}{5}$ to $\frac{17}{5}$ is $2$ more fifths, giving $3\frac{2}{5}$ ✓
